statements.impact_statement: Permission escalation on intermediate-level FILE_UPLOAD directories. This deployment writes uploads to an object store, never to a local MEDIA_ROOT, so the affected directory-permission code path is never taken.
Password-reset account-takeover via unicode case collision. Verifying whether the clinician portal exposes the stock password-reset view.

statements.action_statement: Command injection via lodash.template. Template rendering is used by the report generator with a partially operator-controlled string. Upgrade to 4.17.21 — tracked as CR-4822.
